thread:
Ben: Quick sync on marketplace private-offer + HW partner joint announcement — idea: run a dual-phase onramp credit ladder to accelerate committed spend pre-GA and provide renewal credits post-first-year. Need thoughts on sequencing, legal constraints, and how SI bundle fits in. @Anika @Mike :thinking:
Anika: I like the ladder idea. Timeline question: do we want a short, aggressive pre-announce window (30 days) then a longer conversion window? We should separate the pre-commit voucher (one-time coupon) from renewal credit (applied at renewal). :calendar:
Mike: Legal + finance flag: credits need clear application rules. Prefer: credits as non-refundable marketplace coupons applied to consumption, expiring 12 months after issuance. Also need to ensure partner SKUs map cleanly to Redwood meter IDs.
Sara: Example tiers to discuss (quick sketch):
```
Tier 1: 50k commit -> $5k marketplace credit (coupon)
Tier 2: 150k commit -> $18k credit
Tier 3: 300k+ commit -> $40k credit + SI onboarding credit
```
Keep credits as %discount-equivalent so accounting can treat it as promo.
Josh: Ops note: if coupons are issued via marketplace private-offer flow we can auto-apply, but for on-prem/private deploys we need manual crediting. Also watch for metering delays — prefer credit as invoice-level adjustment rather than token-level.
marketing-bot: Proposed comms sequence: 1) partner co-announcement + private offer link to a landing page; 2) 30-day onramp with visible countdown; 3) case-study signup push during the conversion window. We should include SI enablement kit in week 0. :loudspeaker:
Ben: Good. Two follow-ups: (1) confirm legal language: "credits applied as marketplace coupons, non-refundable, expire 12 months" (Mike), (2) confirm SKU->meter mapping & ops play (Josh). Also decide whether renewal credit is a % of first-year consumption or a fixed coupon.
Anika: For renewal alignment with partner, I recommend fixed coupon tiers (easier to communicate to customers/SIs). E.g., renewals: Tier1 -> $3k, Tier2 -> $10k, Tier3 -> $25k. Keep renewal coupon only redeemable on Redwood private/dedicated plans to avoid cross-cloud issues.
Mike: I'll draft a short term-sheet and add the clause: "Credits cannot be transferred to cash; applied to future Redwood consumption invoices; credits expire if customer downgrades below minimum committed tier." Adding SI enablement dependency: credits contingent on SI completing onboarding checklist (to prevent gaming).
Sara: Ops-friendly tweak: label coupons as "Partner Launch Credit - [PartnerName]" and set automated redemption rules. I can draft the coupon config and share the JSON block for the marketplace tooling.
Josh: I'll build the SKU mapping doc and run a sim of invoice flow. If we keep credits at invoice-level adjustments we avoid token-metering edge cases.
Ben: Action items: Mike -> term-sheet + legal wording by EOD Wed, Sara -> coupon config draft by Thu, Josh -> SKU mapping + ops sim by Fri, Anika -> SI readiness checklist + comms outline. Marketing: schedule co-announcement draft once coupon config is done. Thanks all :rocket: :thumbsup:
marketing-bot: Noted — will reserve co-announcement slot for next sprint and prep PR checklist.
Ben: We'll reconvene after the drafts. If anyone wants to propose alternate ladder percentages, drop them here.
